text: Just a friendly reminder that SWCRS has a monthly social meet-up on the last Friday of the month at Harbottle Brewing Company from 6:00 to 9:00 PM-ish. Come on out, grab a cold beer or soda, meet the local yahoos in person, and bring your radios! It's always a great time to talk shop, show off your gear (or get some help with it), and connect with the community. All ages are welcome so we hope to see you all there!

Just a reminder to donate to SWCRS! Keeping our repeater network running takes real money - site leases, equipment, backhaul, maintenance, insurance, all of it. If we are a service you rely on or enjoy, or both, whether for day to day comms, emergency backup, or just knowing it's there, please consider chipping in. Be a supporter. A few dollars goes a long way toward keeping these resources on the air. You can do so at our website at swcrs.org. We do not charge membership dues; and all our funds come from the good folks that choose to help us out.
